name: Caitlyn NEXT
creator: dear-agony
description:
### Overview

A custom Caitlyn visual update mod inspired by the upcoming game update (NEXT)

While Caitlyn has received a rework, her current in-game model differs noticeably from her established facial features. The Wild Rift model retains more of Caitlyn’s recognizable facial characteristics while giving her a modernized appearance

---

### Assets

**Model:** Base Skin from Wild Rift
**Weapon:** Base Skin weapon from League of Legends

---

### Compatibility

Works with the Base Skin
